sloka: न हि कम्पयितुं शक्यः सुरैरपि महामृधे ।अकम्पनस्ततस्तेषामादित्य इव तेजसा ।। ६.५५.८ ।।।।
transliteration: na hi kampayituṁ śakyaḥ surairapi mahāmṛdhe ।akampanastatasteṣāmāditya iva tejasā ।। 6.55.8 ।।।।

translations.english: Akampana who, possibly could not be shaken in war by suras shone like the sun in that manner.
